evidence.title: NASA and SpaceX Prepare Crew-13 for Launch to the International Space Station
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The mission will launch on a Falcon 9 rocket from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida, continuing the operational sequence of NASA’s Commercial Crew Program. [e001:f02] From left are, Commander Jessica Watkins and Pilot Luke Delaney, both from NASA, and Mission Specialists Joshua Kutryk of CSA (Canadian Space Agency) and Sergey Teteryatnikov of Roscosmos. [e001:f03] NASA But Crew-13 carries an additional historical significance. [e001:f04] Its official mission patch includes a tribute to Apollo 13, the 1970 lunar mission that became one of the most dramatic examples of engineering, teamwork and survival in the history of human spaceflight. [e001:f05] More than five decades after Apollo 13, NASA is once again flying a crewed mission designated with the number 13 — this time without changing the designation or avoiding the number. [e001:f06] Rather than treating 13 as a warning sign, the Crew-13 emblem uses the legacy of Apollo 13 as a reminder of how engineering and human ingenuity can overcome extraordinary circumstances. [e001:f07] The legacy of Apollo 13 The association between NASA and the number 13 became particularly strong in April 1970. [e001:f08] Two days later, on April 13, an oxygen tank in the spacecraft’s Service Module exploded, severely damaging the vehicle and forcing NASA to abandon the planned lunar landing. [e001:f09] Although Apollo 13 failed to achieve its planned lunar landing, NASA ultimately regarded the mission as a remarkable demonstration of engineering capability and crisis management. [e001:f10] When NASA briefly avoided the number 13 The space agency’s relationship with the number 13 became more complicated during the Space Shuttle era. [e001:f11] After the first shuttle missions were designated sequentially as STS-1, STS-2 and so on, NASA introduced a different naming system in the early 1980s. [e001:f12] The new system incorporated elements such as the fiscal year, launch site and mission sequence. [e001:f13] One of the most memorable responses came from the crew of STS-41-C, which launched in April 1984. [e001:f14] SpaceX’s crewed Dragon missions began with the Demo-2 test flight in 2020, followed by the operational Crew-1 mission and subsequent flights. [e001:f15] Crew-13 therefore represents more than another entry in the launch manifest. [e001:f16] For engineers, flight controllers and astronauts, the critical factors remain the same: propulsion performance, trajectory calculations, spacecraft systems, redundancy, weather conditions, communications and continuous monitoring of the v。

evidence.title: SpaceX Hits 700 Falcon Launches as NASA Adds $946 Million and Starship Waits in the Wings
evidence.body: [e002:f01] While attention fixates on the launch pads of Texas — where the Super Heavy booster B21 rolled out to Pad 2 overnight into Monday — the more telling gauge of SpaceX's economic health sits elsewhere. [e002:f02] The company's market valuation stands at EUR 134.28 per share, up 1.4%, yet the real story lies beneath the spectacle of heavy-lift test preparations: an operating engine whose reliability has few peers in the industry. [e002:f03] Media reports indicate SpaceX is targeting no earlier than September 28 for Starship's 14th orbital test flight, following a postponement on Thursday. [e002:f04] A Milestone Above the Atmosphere On September 13, the company notched a landmark: with the launch of the final three O3b mPOWER satellites for SES, the 700th Falcon rocket lifted off. [e002:f05] Another 27 Starlink V2 Mini satellites reached orbit on Saturday, reinforcing a cadence that is no theoretical promise but lived reality — and, in this view, evidence of the operational dominance SpaceX has built over traditional competitors. [e002:f06] On Friday, NASA expanded an existing framework agreement with SpaceX by $946 million, covering three additional crewed missions to the International Space Station designated Crew-15, Crew-16 and Crew-17. [e002:f07] An order book of that scale underscores how indispensable SpaceX has become to the U.S. space agency, securing predictable cash flows that in turn fund the costly development of the next launch vehicle generation. [e002:f08] SpaceX embodies this balancing act between state security infrastructure and the aggressive scaling of a globe-spanning satellite network — a business model that must reconcile military secrecy and civilian mass production under one roof. [e002:f09] The mission's design illustrates the evolutionary leap: mid-September, the company announced it would aim for a roughly ten-hour flight at an altitude of about 275 kilometers, spanning approximately six Earth orbits, followed by a controlled descent in the Pacific Ocean west of Chile. [e002:f10] This is no longer merely about leaving the atmosphere — the focus is on the logistical capability to deploy heavy payloads precisely and return the launch system under control. [e002:f11] Valuation Leaves Little Room for Error This two-track approach — reliable state contractor and risk-taking fleet operator — shapes how the capital market sees the company. [e002:f12] Such a valuation no longer reflects only the imagination of a pioneer; it mirrors the expectation that SpaceX can permanently convert its dominant position in orbital transport into operating profitability. [e002:f13] With a valuation that leaves little room for operational missteps, investor expectations for the future Starship system are enormous — after all, the vehicle is meant to carry larger payloads such as the planned V3 Starlink satellites. [e002:f14] The danger lies primarily in delays during the generational change of rocket systems, not in the existing business model. [e002:f15] As long as the core business delivers returns this smoothly, SpaceX can afford the patience required on the road to its next technological leap — a combination of profitable Falcon missions, long-term government contracts and the rapid build-out of the Starlink fleet that argues for a persistently strong market position. [e002:f16] Ad SpaceX Stock: New Analysis - 22 September Fresh SpaceX information released.

evidence.title: Starlink Mobile Launches in Uganda via Airtel Partnership
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The service went live on September 24, 2026, through a partnership with Airtel Uganda, targeting rural and remote communities where conventional cell coverage doesn't reach. [e003:f02] For the millions of Ugandans without reliable mobile internet, it's a meaningful shift — satellite connectivity delivered through an existing carrier relationship, no dish required. [e003:f03] Source: @Starlink — September 24, 2026 ▶ Watch Video on X The Deal Behind the Launch This isn't a standalone rollout — it's the first visible output of a broader agreement. [e003:f04] According to reporting from Space in Africa and TechAfrica News, Airtel Africa and SpaceX formalized a partnership in December 2025 to bring Starlink Direct-to-Cell across all 14 of Airtel Africa's operating markets. [e003:f05] Uganda is the first of those 14 markets to go live under this arrangement, following the Democratic Republic of Congo, which Starlink cited as the continent's first launch. [e003:f06] Airtel Uganda acts as the distribution and billing layer, meaning subscribers access the service through their existing Airtel relationship rather than setting up a separate Starlink account. [e003:f07] For those communities, Starlink Mobile offers something genuinely new: apps and messaging over satellite, using the phone already in hand. [e003:f08] The use cases Starlink highlighted in its announcement are deliberately modest — apps and messaging, not streaming — which reflects both the current capability ceiling of Direct-to-Cell and a realistic picture of what rural connectivity needs look like. [e003:f09] For SpaceX, carrier partnerships convert what would otherwise be a hardware-dependent consumer product into a wholesale connectivity layer — a fundamentally different business model than selling Starlink terminals to individual households. [e003:f10] What Comes Next With Uganda live and the DRC preceding it, the Airtel Africa rollout is now officially underway. [e003:f11] The remaining 12 markets in Airtel's footprint — which span Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, and others — represent the next wave of potential launches, though no specific timelines have been announced publicly. [e003:f12] For SpaceX, the Africa push is also a proof-of-concept for the carrier partnership model globally. [e003:f13] The Uganda launch is small in isolation — but as the second data point in a 14-market rollout, it's worth watching closely. evidence.title: アジア初契約！ KDDIとSpaceX、次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」で圏外エリアの高速通信目指す
evidence.body: [e005:f01] KDDI株式会社は9月15日、衛星とスマートフォンの直接通信サービス「au Starlink Direct」において、Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（SpaceX）との間で次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」のサービス提供契約を8月10日に締結したと発表しました。 [e005:f02] 同社によると、この契約はアジアで初めての事例となるとのことです。 [e005:f03] 目次 圏外エリアでも高速通信と音声通話を目指す 今回の契約は、圏外エリアでの高速データ通信と音声通話の提供を目的としたものです。 [e005:f04] これまでの「au Starlink Direct」はメッセージ送受信や対応アプリによるデータ通信が中心でしたが、日常利用に近いブロードバンド通信と音声通話（VoLTE）の提供を2027年内に目指すとのことです。 [e005:f05] 次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」の性能 次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」は、第1世代の衛星と比較してアンテナサイズが拡大されています。 [e005:f06] 同社の発表によると、衛星1基あたり約20倍のスループットを実現するとともに、より多数の通信ビームを活用することで約100倍のデータ密度を実現し、通信性能が大幅に向上するということです。 [e005:f07] KDDIはこの契約を通じて、圏外エリアにおける通信手段をさらに拡充する方針を示しています。 [e005:f08] KDDIとSpaceXのこれまでの取り組み KDDIとSpaceXは、2021年の「Starlink」導入に向けた業務提携以降、au基地局のバックホール回線にStarlinkを採用したほか、法人・自治体向け「Starlink Business」の国内初提供を行ってきました。 [e005:f09] 災害発生時にはStarlinkを無償提供し、避難所における通信復旧にも取り組んできたとのことです。 [e005:f10] 2025年4月からは「au Starlink Direct」の提供を開始しており、2026年には海外ローミング接続や、SOS発信による緊急時の救助要請への対応、IoTデバイスやAIドローンとの直接通信などにも活用領域を広げているとのことです。 [e005:f11] これまでの主な取り組み Starlinkとの業務提携（2021年9月13日） 法人・自治体向け「Starlink Business」提供（2022年10月12日） au通信網でのStarlink利用開始（2022年12月1日） 能登半島の避難所にStarlink350台を無償提供（2024年1月7日） 「au Starlink Direct」提供開始（2025年4月10日） 世界初の海外ローミング接続開始（2026年3月4日） 「au Starlink Direct SOSセンター」新設（2026年4月23日） 「au Starlink Direct」のIoT接続（国内初、2026年4月23日） 圏外エリアでの衛星直接通信ドローン飛行実証成功（2026年7月22日） 両社の代表者がコメント SpaceXのPresident and COOを務めるGwynne Shotwellさんは、次世代Starlink Mobile V2を通じてKDDIとともに日本の利用者へ強靭でシームレスな通信体験を届けられることを喜ばしく思うとコメントしています。 [e005:f12] 同氏は、両社の強みを掛け合わせることで、場所や環境に左右されずに多くの人がつながる世界を実現していきたいとも述べています。 [e005:f13] KDDI代表取締役社長CEOの松田浩路さんは、SpaceXの拠点であるテキサス州Starbaseを訪れ、Shotwellさんと今後の構想について意見を交わしたことを明らかにしています。 [e005:f14] 松田さんは、Starlink Mobile V2をはじめとする今回の取り組みが、KDDIが掲げる「AI前提社会を支える次世代インフラ構想」と重なるものだとした上で、今後もつながる力の進化に取り組んでいく考えを示しました。 [e005:f15] 詳細は KDDIニュースルーム で案内されています。 [e005:f16] KDDIニュースルーム： https:// ニュース Starlink Mobile V2 目次。

evidence.title: Report reveals that one of investor's biggest fears about SpaceX stock never actually happened.
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The SpaceX IPO was so big that investors worried it could reshape overall market structure. [e001:f02] Morningstar says the impact so far has been limited. [e001:f03] SpaceX stock has had a volatile ride since its record-setting debut this summer. [e001:f04] Elon Musk's rocket and AI company was hot out of the gate, but didn't sustain its momentum for long. [e001:f05] Importantly for investors watching from the sidelines, the splashy IPO hasn't reshaped the market in the way many had feared it might leading up to the debut. [e001:f06] Morningstar on Wednesday flagged that SpaceX's colossal market cap didn't translate into the overweighting at the index level many investors had been concerned about. [e001:f07] This was a worry percolating in the market as index providers changed their rules to fast track the stock into major averages like the Nasdaq 100. [e001:f08] "Despite reaching a $2 trillion market cap on its first day of trading, limited public float meant SpaceX represented only about 0.1% of the Total Market Index at the end of August, despite earlier fears surrounding its expedited inclusion in indexes," stated director of analytics Alex Poukchanski. [e001:f09] The concern was that funds that track the indexes would be forced to buy SpaceX, leaving investors exposed to the company even if they weren't interested in the IPO. [e001:f10] Given that popular indexes like the Nasdaq 100 are cap-weighted, there were fears that index funds would end up dumping other stocks to make room for SpaceX with its enormous market capitalization. [e001:f11] The fear has been mostly unfounded, for now. [e001:f12] For investors, this is a good sign ahead of other mega-IPOs, and rule changes might not be the market-breaking force some feared. [e001:f13] But Poukchanski added that extreme concentration is still a risk in the era of giant tech IPOs. [e001:f14] Giants like Anthropic and OpenAI will likely overshadow smaller offerings, and exacerbate that risk, he said. [e001:f15] "With anticipated IPOs from Anthropic and OpenAI, alongside continued subdued small-cap IPO activity, top-level market concentration could continue to rise, requiring further adjustments to the mega-cap segment to keep the indexes aligned with the market," Poukchanski added.

evidence.title: Vietjet signs deal with Starlink for free in-flight WiFi on Vietnam airline
Vietjet signs with Starlink to bring free high-speed Wi-Fi to its entire network
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The agreement was signed in New York on 23 September 2026 between SpaceX, which engineers and operates the Starlink network, and Vietjet together with its group companies Galaxy Holdings and Galaxy Telecom. [e003:f02] Vietnam's General Secretary and President To Lam attended the exchange during his working visit to the United States, joined by senior officials and business leaders from both countries, giving the deal a diplomatic profile that few airline connectivity contracts ever achieve. ## 120 aircraft in the first wave Starlink will first be fitted to 120 Vietjet aircraft, comprising 100 narrowbody Airbus A321 and Boeing 737 jets alongside 20 Airbus A330 widebodies that operate the airline's longer international sectors. [e003:f03] Vietjet plans to equip every new aircraft it takes delivery of with the system, so connectivity will grow in step with the fleet across both its Vietnamese domestic network and its fast-expanding international map. [e003:f04] Starlink's satellites sit in low Earth orbit, much closer to the ground than the geostationary satellites behind most traditional inflight Wi-Fi systems, which gives the service the low latency needed for video calls and streaming in the cabin. [e003:f05] Vietjet will offer the service free of charge on every Vietjet-branded flight, with the airline setting out an ambition to make fast inflight Wi-Fi an everyday part of air travel that every traveller can use. [e003:f06] Vietjet Chairwoman Dr Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao said: "With Starlink, time in the air no longer has to mean time offline. [e003:f07] Vietjet passengers will be able to stay connected throughout their journey, whether working, staying entertained, or keeping in touch with family and friends. [e003:f08] This reflects Vietjet's longstanding commitment to innovation and our ambition to bring leading technologies closer to more people." ! [e003:f09] [Image 1](https:// Vietjet and SpaceX exchanged the agreement to bring high-speed internet to Vietjet flights, in the presence of Vietnam's General Secretary and President To Lam, senior officials and business leaders from Vietnam and the United States. [e003:f10] "We're thrilled to deliver a connectivity experience to Vietjet and its customers, making every journey better, smoother and infinitely more enjoyable." Vietjet describes the agreement as the beginning of a long-term technology relationship with SpaceX, which sits alongside its continued investment in data, artificial intelligence and skilled talent as it builds what it calls a digital aviation ecosystem for the millions of passengers it carries each year. ## A network and fleet on the move The Starlink deal arrives during one of the busiest growth periods in Vietjet's history. [e003:f11] Australian travellers have more to look forward to as well, with Ho Chi Minh City to Western Sydney International launching on 9 January 2027. [e003:f12] Vietjet has ordered 100 Airbus A321neo aircraft, signed a US$3.8 billion Trent 7000 engine agreement with Rolls-Royce for its widebody fleet and selected Pratt & Whitney to power 44 further A320neo family jets, while its partnership with CFM International explores maintenance capability for the latest-generation LEAP engines in Vietnam. [e003:f13] Passengers can choose from Eco, Deluxe, SkyBoss and Business fares, with the SkyJoy loyalty programme rewarding frequent flyers across the network. ## Recognised by AirlineRatings Vietjet's growth has come without any compromise on safety. [e003:f14] The airline has held a seven-star safety rating with AirlineRatings since 2018, and in January it was named among the World's Safest Airlines for 2026, ranking alongside easyJet, Southwest Airlines and Ryanair. [e003:f15] Announcing the result, then AirlineRatings CEO Sharon Petersen said: "Vietjet Air has delivered steady growth while maintaining fleet continuity and a high level of operational reliability." In March Vietjet was named World's Best Ultra Low-Cost Carrier for 2026, a title it has held every year since 2018, and earned a place in the top ten World's Best Low-Cost Airlines for 2026. [e003:f16] With free satellite Wi-Fi now joining a safety record and product offering that have earned recognition from both our editorial panel and our readers, Vietjet is giving travellers across Asia and beyond one more reason to choose the airline for their next journey.

evidence.title: Launches FALCON Verify to Bring Trust, Reliability, and Verification to AI-Generated Answers
evidence.body: [e005:f01] One Intelligence | today announced the availability of FALCON Verify, a new AI verification capability designed to address a fundamental challenge with generative AI: an AI answer can sound convincing even when part, or all of it is wrong. [e005:f02] FALCON Verify works inside ChatGPT and Claude, connects in under a minute, and is free for 25 checks per month. [e005:f03] AI assistants are increasingly used for research, analysis, writing, data analysis, sales, customer support and business decisions. [e005:f04] FALCON Verify makes AI trustworthy.” — Deepesh Desai, Founder and CEO But confidence is not evidence, and a confident answer is not necessarily a reliable one. [e005:f05] FALCON Verify was built to help answer that question. [e005:f06] A 2025 EBU/BBC study found 45% of more than 3,000 AI responses contained at least one significant issue. [e005:f07] Stanford researchers found 17–33% hallucination rates in specialized AI legal research tools. [e005:f08] In One Intelligence’s internal SEC filing tests, 54% of AI-generated statements were not supported by the provided filing. [e005:f09] Then Ask FALCON: FALCON Verify adds one simple step to the way people already use AI. [e005:f10] After connecting FALCON to ChatGPT or Claude, whenever an answer matters, the user says: “FALCON, verify that.” Related Posts Leviton Accelerates AI and Smart Building Network Infrastructure with New $100 Million Global Capital Investment Sep 25, 2026 Lightning AI Expands Executive Team with Key Finance, Marketing, and People Leader Appointments Sep 25, 2026 SoundHound AI Introduces OASYS Edge, Bringing Fully Embedded Agentic Voice AI to Vehicles and Smart Devices Sep 25, 2026 Prev Next 1 of 43,632 FALCON examines the AI-generated response statement by statement against available evidence and evaluates each checkable claim. [e005:f11] FALCON is designed to make the basis for verification visible rather than asking users to blindly trust another AI checking the first one. [e005:f12] For example, an AI might report that revenue grew 18% to $2.4 billion, operating margin was 21%, and guidance was raised. [e005:f13] If the source actually shows 12% growth, a 21% margin and reaffirmed guidance, FALCON checks the statements individually, identifying what is supported and what is contradicted, along with the evidence behind each verdict. [e005:f14] FALCON Verify can be added to ChatGPT or Claude as a connector and can also be integrated into software, AI agents and products. [e005:f15] The Free plan includes 25 checks per month with no credit card required, while enterprise customers can deploy FALCON within their own network. [e005:f16] Prev Post Navatar Turns Claude and Salesforce Into a Live AI Deal Engine for Private Equity and M&A Next Post Crusoe and Thinking Machines Lab Partner to Power Open-Model Inference at Scale You might also like More from author Machine Learning Leviton Accelerates AI and Smart Building Network Infrastructure with New $100… Machine Learning Lightning AI Expands Executive Team with Key Finance, Marketing, and People Leader… Machine Learning SoundHound AI Introduces OASYS Edge, Bringing Fully Embedded Agentic Voice AI to… Cloud DeepInfra Appoints Slava Brin as Chief Financial Officer Prev Next Comments are closed.

evidence.title: Blair Levin’s Conspiracy Theory – Lutnick Delayed BEAD Just to Help Musk’s Starlink
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Wes Moore (D) Signs Data Center Executive Order ■ Reps. [e006:f02] Guthrie, Pallone Introduce Bill to Update FCC’s Covered List ■ New Sanders AI Bill Includes 20 Years in Prison for Violations ■ Phoenix Center Study Returns Odd Findings on Media Bias ■ OpenVault CEO Mark Trudeau Sees ‘Explosion’ in Upstream Data Usage ■ CommLaw Group’s James Booth: Verizon Fiber Outage Sent a Message ■ Muni-Funded Gorgeous Broadband Launches in Oregon NTIA: BEAD Conspiracy Syndrome is catching on in Washington, D.C. [e006:f03] Tech Dirt writer Karl Bode has falsely reported three times since Aug. [e006:f04] 31 that NTIA Administrator Arielle Roth corruptly steered “billions” in BEAD dollars to Starlink parent SpaceX and Amazon Leo when in fact the two barely got $1 billion combined. [e006:f05] Now, Wall Street analyst Blair Levin is circulating his own BEAD conspiracy theory, but his theory seems to be a few LEO satellites short of a constellation. [e006:f06] But that won’t stop people like Bode from amplifying it eventually. [e006:f07] “I would note something that I think Wall Street understands well, but no one in Washington does – what [Commerce Secretary Howard] Lutnick did for [SpaceX CEO Elon] Musk was fantastic, but not because he gave Musk more money in BEAD, but because he delayed the competition to Musk with fiber for a couple of years,” Levin said Sept. [e006:f08] 23 in a live webcast hosted by Fiber Broadband Association CEO Gary Bolton . [e006:f09] It’s as if Levin wanted people to forget the Biden administration did not connect a single fiber location in the 38 months it had after BEAD became law. [e006:f10] Meanwhile, Roth visited the city of Ogallala, Nebraska in May to celebrate the first BEAD-funded fixed wireless connection just 10 months after being sworn in. evidence.body: [e005:f01] プレスリリース 株式会社ディー・エル・イー（本社：東京都千代田区、代表取締役社長CEO・CCO：小野 亮、以下DLE）は、財務省と連携し、税の仕組みについて幅広い世代に向けてわかりやすく解説する全4話のアニメ「税とあなたと鷹の爪」をYouTubeで公開しました。 [e005:f02] 『消費税』財務省×鷹の爪団 https:// ■ 鷹の爪団が「税」の仕組みをアニメでわかりやすく解説！ [e005:f03] 本アニメシリーズは『秘密結社 鷹の爪』の吉田くんが給料から天引きされている税金を見て嘆くシーンからはじまり、それに対して総統が税金（消費税・所得税）の仕組みから税の公平性までコミカルな掛け合いを通じ、わかりやすく解説しています。 [e005:f04] 動画内では下記ポイントを詳しく説明しています ・消費税の仕組みや直接税と間接税との違い ・「収入」と「所得」の違い、所得控除や税率の考え方など、所得税の仕組み ・税の公平性などの「税の三原則」や、いろいろな税目をバランスよく混ぜ合わせる『タックスミックス』 ・税と暮らし、社会のつながりや、税の使われ方を知り、自分で考えることの大切さ DLEは本アニメシリーズを通じて、税金が身近な暮らしや社会を支える大切な仕組みであることを伝え、幅広い世代が税について考え、関心を持つきっかけとなることを目指しています。 [e005:f05] 子どもも大人も親しみやすく共感が持てる『秘密結社 鷹の爪』を通じ、社会課題の解決に向けた活動を支援してまいります。 [e005:f06] ■全4話の構成（各話 約4分） 『秘密結社 鷹の爪』公式YouTubeチャンネルにて公開中。 [e005:f07] 『税金の公平性』財務省×鷹の爪団： https:// ［EP4］考えるぜい！ [e005:f08] 『税金と未来』財務省×鷹の爪団： https:// ■財務省 関連URL： https:// ■株式会社ディー・エル・イー 概要 証券コード：3686（東証スタンダード） 代表者：代表取締役社長CEO・CCO 小野亮 所在地：東京都千代田区麹町3-3-4 KDX 麹町ビル７階 創立日：2001年12月27日 HP： https:// 『秘密結社 鷹の爪』をはじめとするIP（著作権等の知的財産権）の企画開発やアニメ・キャラクター等のコンテンツ制作事業を軸に2014年に東証に上場。 [e005:f09] 現在はアジアを代表するエンターテインメントであるアニメとキャラクターを中心に事業を展開している。 [e005:f10] 2025年には自社IPをフル活用したAIキャラクター子会社「キャビア」の設立や、ミドルクオリティのアニメーションを短納期で実現させる「オルタナティブ・アニメ」事業の展開、AI映像スタジオ「OBETA AI STUDIO」開設など、AIとIPを組み合わせた新たな取り組みを進め、事業をさらに加速させている。 [e005:f11] コロナビールが伝えるブランドメッセージ 0 2026.08.26 コスパ・タイパの次は楽パ！ [e005:f12] pdcが新ライン発売でスキンケアの新たな価値観を提案 0 2026.08.25 「ひらけ、ごまの可能性。 [e005:f13] 詳しくは 利用規約 をご覧ください。 [e005:f14] URLにアクセスしてパスワードを再設定してください。

evidence.title: レイヤードの初値は２２３０円、公開価格を５９％上回る
日経平均は4日続伸、米半導体株高を好感 金利上昇警戒で伸び悩む
evidence.body: [e007:f01] REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon [東京 ２４日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は４日続伸し、前営業日比０．７６％（４９５円０４銭）高の６万５５１３円９９銭で取引を終えた。 [e007:f02] 大型連休中に米国株式市場で人工知能（ＡＩ）・半導体関連株が上昇したことを好感。 [e007:f03] 日本株もその動きを受け、終始買い優勢となった。 [e007:f04] ただ、金利上昇に対する警戒感が強く、中盤から伸び悩む展開。 [e007:f05] シルバーウイーク中の米株市場では、フィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）が２３日こそ軟化したものの、連休前の１８日終値との比較で５．１％上昇となっており、日本の半導体関連株もこれに連動する形となった。 [e007:f06] そうした中で、米長期金利が上昇基調を継続するとともに、国内の長期金利も上昇。 [e007:f07] 利回りは一時３．０７５％と１９９６年８月以来３０年ぶりの高水準を更新した。 [e007:f08] 金利上昇はＡＩ関連以外の、金利・為替動向が直接収益に結び付く業種の株価には逆風になるとの見方が出ている。 [e007:f09] 市場では「連休中の米株市場でＡＩ関連株が上昇したことが、日経平均を支える格好となったものの、全体的には金融政策に反応しやすい地合いが続いている。 [e007:f10] 景気敏感株のみならず、金融株がさえない現況から、景気悪化の中で金利が上昇するスタグフレーションを市場は警戒していると言えそうだ」（野村証券・ストラテジストの秋山渉氏）との指摘もある。 [e007:f11] ＴＯＰＩＸは０．３９％安の４０７５．３ポイントで取引を終えた。 [e007:f12] 東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．３９％安の２１０２．４２ポイントだった。 [e007:f13] プライム市場の売買代金は９兆２０３８億８６００万円だった。 [e007:f14] 東証３３業種では、値上がりは海運や鉱業、保険など１６業種、値下がりはその他製品や精密機器、医薬品など１７業種。 [e007:f15] 新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が小幅安となり、０．１％（０．７９ポイント）安の８０８．１９ポイントだった。 [e007:f16] 東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが６７４銘柄（４３％）、値下がりは８３８銘柄（５３％）、変わらずは４２銘柄（２％）だった。

evidence.title: 東証、午前終値は6万6318円 米ハイテク株高、金利上昇
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 上げ幅は一時800円を超え、6万6000円を回復した。 [e008:f02] 前日の米ハイテク株高を受け、東京市場でも人工知能（AI）、半導体関連銘柄の一部に買いが入り、相場を支えた。 [e008:f03] 長期金利の上昇により銀行株などにも買いが広がった。 [e008:f04] 午前終値は前日終値比804円15銭高の6万6318円14銭。 [e008:f05] 東証株価指数（TOPIX）は48.43ポイント高の4123.73。 [e008:f06] 前日の米国株式市場では、ハイテク株主体の株価指数が上昇し、東京市場でも平均株価への寄与度が高い半導体製造装置大手の東京エレクトロンやアドバンテストなどが買われた。 [e008:f07] 外部リンク 東証終値495円高 東証、午前終値864円高 東証続伸、終値6万5513円 半導体やAI関連銘柄値上がり NY株式 23日終値 東証、784円高 午前9時15分現在 この記事の関連ニュース 東証続伸、終値は850円高 米ハイテク株高、金利上昇で買い 共同通信(2026年9月25日 15時44分) 東証、一時700円超高 米株高が追い風 共同通信(2026年9月18日 12時45分) 東証、午前終値は6万3966円 米ハイテク株高で買い注文先行 共同通信(2026年9月17日 11時48分) 東証大幅続落、終値1889円安 全面安、長期金利上昇が重荷 共同通信(2026年9月2日 15時38分) 東証一時1900円超下落 金利上昇重荷、トリプル安 共同通信(2026年9月2日 10時5分)。
